label: Pullquote
when: one short line the page wants to stand out (a motto, the founder's words, a highlighted quote)
rules:
One core/pullquote per quote, no inner blocks, saved as HTML: figure, blockquote, the quote in

, the author in after it (leave out when unknown). Only for one short line that should stand out, never for body text. Use the member's own words: never invent a customer's quote or name. Centered: "style":{"typography":{"textAlign":"center"}} first, and class has-text-align-center first on the figure. Colors only as palette slugs: "backgroundColor" and "textColor", with the classes as in the example. No other attributes (no "textAlign" of its own).
